title: GTA 6 Can Drive Your Car For You (Even Boats) 🚗 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has a hidden auto-drive. Set a waypoint, switch to the cinematic camera, then hold Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox), and Jason or Lucia drives you there. The AI follows traffic rules and stops at red lights, the triggers speed it up or slow it down, and it even works on boats if the waypoint can be reached by water. Tip: some guides say to set Auto-Drive to "Unrestricted" in the settings first.

Sources: Beebom (How to Auto-Drive in GTA 6), PlayDay (GTA 6 Auto-Drive Guide), Rockstar Intel (30+ hidden GTA VI controls).
Images: Rockstar Games (official trailers / An Extended Look / official screenshot).
